scripts.build: cd teacher-student-app && npm run build && mkdir -p build/chase && cp -r ../villain-chase-game/* build/chase/ && cp build/villian.png build/chase/villain.png && cp -r build/chase build/villain-chase-game
scripts.commit-and-push: git add . && git commit -m "Deploy: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" && git push origin main
scripts.build-and-deploy: npm run build && npm run commit-and-push && npm run deploy
